best_human.provenance: The 26-circle source file supplies equal-radius coordinates with r=0.096362339010, attributed in the selected research summary to Nurmela–Östergård (1999). The 32-circle source file supplies r=0.087858157088; the selected research summary attributes that construction to D. W. Boll, J. Donovan, R. L. Graham, and B. D. Lubachevsky (2000). Each coordinate set is translated from a square centered at the origin. Every radius is reduced by 1/10^9 for exact feasibility after decimal rounding. These feasible equal-circle constructions are transferred to the variable-radius class; they do not establish variable-radius optimality. For T003-C03 the public variable-radius order-40 Packomania witness was conservatively reproduced from the saved same-parameter coordinate source. C03 uses the classical equal-circle N=40 construction listed under [11], R. L. Graham and B. D. Lubachevsky (1996); coordinates are saved and each radius is conservatively reduced. The N=40 equal-circle row cites reference [11], Graham and Lubachevsky (1996); source coordinates are saved at data/csq40_source.txt and the exact objective is 79186752517/25000000000.
